name: Skills library renders the seeded skills and opens the tabbed editor
description: Loads /skills, confirms a seeded skill card is rendered by SkillCard, then clicks it and confirms the /skills/:id editor opens on its Config tab with the description labelled as the skill's interface, and that the Versions tab lists its history. Exercises the skills grid, GET /skills, the list→detail route, and GET /skills/:id/versions. Read-only seeded data (no model call, nothing written).

steps.label: the detail route opens on Config
